step1_analysis.description: A fully differential two-stage operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) with a PMOS input differential pair and NMOS common-source second stage. It is designed to be load-compensated for use in a switched-capacitor sigma-delta modulator. Note: The paper mentions class-AB operation, but the extracted netlist shows a standard Class-A topology, suggesting the dynamic biasing circuitry may have been omitted in this specific schematic.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 140-W 88-dB Audio Sigma-Delta Modulator in 90-nm CMOS

dc_gain.description: Open-loop DC differential gain of the OTA

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm1*(ro1||ro3) * gm2*(ro2||ro4). With L=0.5u, intrinsic gain per stage is ~30-40dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Two stages of amplification in 130nm typically yield 60-80 dB depending on biasing and output resistance.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGF = gm1 / (2*pi*CL). Assuming gm1 ~ 100uS and CL = 1pF, UGF ~ 16 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load capacitance since the architecture is load-compensated.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the separation between the dominant pole (at output) and non-dominant pole (at first stage output).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Requires sufficient load capacitance to push the dominant pole to a low frequency for stability.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total * VDD. If I_tail=10uA and I_stage2=20uA*2, I_total=50uA. Power = 50uA * 1.8V = 90uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for 1.8V supply in SKY130 compared to 1V in the original 90nm paper.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for measuring DC gain, UGF, phase margin, and power of the fully differential OTA. Ideal CMFB is added to stabilize the high-impedance nodes for open-loop AC analysis.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Two-Stage Fully Differential OTA Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

* Renamed duplicate XM2 to XM2_N and XM2_P to avoid SPICE errors
XM2_N N5 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM2_P OUTN LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 OUTN N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 OUTP LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUTP N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM1 N5 INN N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM8 N0 INP N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N0 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

* Load Capacitors for load-compensation
CL1 OUTP 0 1p
CL2 OUTN 0 1p

* Power Supply and Fixed Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9

* Ideal Common-Mode Feedback (CMFB) for DC stabilization
* First stage CMFB: controls NMOS loads to keep N5 and N0 at 0.9V
B_CMFB1 N3 0 V='0.9 + 100*(v(N5)+v(N0)-1.8)'
* Second stage CMFB: controls PMOS loads to keep OUTP and OUTN at 0.9V
B_CMFB2 LABEL_NET_0 0 V='0.9 + 100*(v(OUTP)+v(OUTN)-1.8)'
B_CMFB3 LABEL_NET_2 0 V='0.9 + 100*(v(OUTP)+v(OUTN)-1.8)'

* Input Signals (Differential)
VINP INP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 10u 1MEG)
VINN INN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 -10u 1MEG)

.control
* DC Operating Point and Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1 1G
let out_diff = v(OUTP) - v(OUTN)
let gain_db = 20*log10(mag(out_diff))
let phase = 180/PI * cph(out_diff)

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac pm_raw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
let phase_margin = pm_raw + 180
print phase_margin

* Transient Analysis
tran 1n 5u
meas tran vout_p_max max v(OUTP)
meas tran vout_p_min min v(OUTP)
.endc
.end
